sources.text: If export license applications are denied, we may be unable to ship some products. Applications remain under review.

cases.reason: The translation preserves the condition and uncertainty.

cases.claim: All shipments will stop because the export licenses have been denied.

sources.text: If export license applications are denied, we may be unable to ship some products. Applications remain under review.

cases.reason: Turns a possible conditional consequence into an actual denial and certain universal outcome.

cases.claim: Excess inventory may cause lower customer demand.

sources.text: Lower customer demand may lead to excess inventory. We monitor demand when planning production.

cases.reason: The source establishes the opposite causal direction.

cases.claim: Supplier interruptions may delay deliveries and cause customer data breaches.

sources.text: Supplier interruptions may delay deliveries. We maintain inventory to reduce the impact of these interruptions.

cases.reason: The delivery clause is supported, but the data-breach clause is absent.

cases.claim: Changing certain suppliers can take time.

sources.text: Some components are obtained from sole-source suppliers. Qualifying replacement suppliers for these components may require significant time.

cases.reason: A less specific, faithful summary of replacement qualification time.
